final_answer_text:
Short answer: **not yet — and your chart is unusually specific about why.**

**What your 10th house actually promises (this part is strong).**
Your career signature is genuinely good, and I want to be clear that this is not flattery:
- In the **Daśāṃśa (D10)** — the divisional chart that specifically governs career and professional standing — your **Moon is exalted in the 10th house**, with the Sun also in that 10th. An exalted graha in the 10th of the D10 is a first-rank professional signature.
- **Jupiter is in its own sign (Pisces)** in the D10, and carries the highest Aṣṭakavarga piṇḍa in that chart (55, against a Sarva of 336).
- Two classically-confirmed yogas bear directly on your career significators: **Śaśa Yoga** (one of the five Pañcha-Mahāpuruṣa yogas, formed by Saturn) and **Budha-Āditya Yoga** (Mercury with the Sun — intelligence applied through office).

So the *promise* is not in question. The question is the *timing*, and there the answer changes.

**Why now is not the moment.**
- You are in the final year of a **Mercury Mahādaśā that runs out on 18 August 2027**, currently in its Saturn sub-period. The tail of a 17-year daśā is characteristically a period of winding-down rather than fresh launching.
- The system carries **no career activation window anywhere in the next twelve months.** The nearest one opens **18 August 2027 and peaks 1 November 2027** — i.e. precisely when the Mercury daśā hands over. Everything before that is undifferentiated background.
- I checked directly for an auspicious window to launch a professional undertaking in the next 90 days. The best available in that whole span scores **0.67 and grades "Silver — solid but not ideal," and no gold-tier window exists at all** in the searched horizon. The single best slot is 30 October – 1 November 2026, if you are forced to move.
- Net **argala on your 10th house is exactly 0** — support and obstruction cancel. That is a precise picture of "pushing produces no net movement."

**Two things I will not smooth over.**
1. The transit sweep shows **three gain-windows and three loss-windows** for career over the next three years — it is genuinely balanced, not favourable. A **career setback window is flagged for February 2028, peaking 7 February**, sitting uncomfortably close to the good 2027 activation. The advancement point lands **5 September 2028**.
2. Your chart carries a **live, unresolved contradiction tagged specifically to career** — classed `domain_promise_vs_denial`, meaning two signals of comparable weight say the 10th house delivers and does not deliver. The system offers no automated adjudication for it and explicitly marks it as needing acharya-level resolution. I am not going to pretend that tension away: it is the strongest single reason to be cautious about a confident answer here.

**What I would actually advise.** Prepare now, move later. Use the remaining Mercury period for positioning — conversations, credentials, and the network — and target the **August 2027 – January 2028 opening, around November 2027**, for the actual switch. If circumstances force your hand before then, 30 October – 1 November 2026 is the least-bad window available.

**Confidence.** Moderate on the structural reading (D10 and the two yogas are hard, cited chart facts). Low-to-moderate on the dates: every timing figure here is labelled by the system as a *structural prior, pre-calibration* — zero recorded outcomes back it — and the election engine notes that several of its own scoring axes (personal field alignment, rite-specific resonance) could not be computed for this chart at all.
